R-security-1 (Invoice detail endpoint returns any organization's invoice (IDOR)) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Scope the lookup to the caller's organization, as the list route does: call currentUser(req) and query "... WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2" with [id, user.orgId], answering 404 when no row matches so other organizations' ids are not revealed. Add a test where a user of org 7 asks for an invoice of org 8 and gets 404. Attack: any authenticated user sends GET /invoices/1, /invoices/2, ... and reads every organization's invoices (CWE-639 / CWE-862).
findings.title: Invoice detail endpoint returns any organization's invoice (IDOR)

findings.recommendation: Keep logging the error server-side, but answer a generic body such as { error: "internal error" } without err.message or err.stack. Scenario: any request whose handler throws (a database failure, a malformed query) returns file paths, module layout and driver error text — possibly SQL or connection details — to the caller (CWE-209).
findings.title: Error handler sends the exception message and stack trace to the client
